text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 47 से 49 तक ‘The Lost Camel’ पढ़ो। फिर किताब के सवालों के जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 47 se 49 tak ‘The Lost Camel’ padho. Phir kitaab ke sawaalon ke jawab do.
text.en: Read ‘The Lost Camel’ on pages 47 to 49 of your book. Then answer the book's questions.

steps.question: Why were the two merchants surprised at the old man's questions?

questionMeaning.hi: व्यापारी बूढ़े आदमी के सवालों से हैरान क्यों थे?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Vyaapaari boodhe aadmi ke sawaalon se hairaan kyon the?

options: Because all his questions about the camel were correct.
steps.answer: Because all his questions about the camel were correct.
steps.modelAnswer: The merchants were surprised because the old man's questions were all correct. The camel was old, lame and blind in the left eye.

modelMeaning.hi: व्यापारी हैरान थे क्योंकि बूढ़े आदमी की सारी बातें सही थीं। ऊँट बूढ़ा, लंगड़ा और बाईं आँख से अंधा था।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Vyaapaari hairaan the kyonki boodhe aadmi ki saari baatein sahi thin. Oont boodha, langda aur baayin aankh se andha tha.

steps.question: Why did the merchants think that the old man had seen the camel?

questionMeaning.hi: व्यापारियों को क्यों लगा कि बूढ़े आदमी ने ऊँट देखा है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Vyaapaariyon ko kyon laga ki boodhe aadmi ne oont dekha hai?

options: He knew it was carrying wheat and honey.
steps.answer: He knew it was carrying wheat and honey.
steps.modelAnswer: They thought he had seen the camel because he knew so much about it, even that it was carrying wheat and honey.

modelMeaning.hi: उन्हें लगा उसने ऊँट देखा है क्योंकि वह सब जानता था, यहाँ तक कि ऊँट पर गेहूँ और शहद था।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Unhe laga usne oont dekha hai kyonki woh sab jaanta tha, yahan tak ki oont par gehoon aur shahad tha.

steps.question: Why did they take the old man to the Khalifa?

questionMeaning.hi: वे बूढ़े आदमी को ख़लीफ़ा के पास क्यों ले गए?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Woh boodhe aadmi ko Khalifa ke paas kyon le gaye?

options: They thought he had stolen the goods and killed the camel.
He wanted to meet the Khalifa.
steps.answer: They thought he had stolen the goods and killed the camel.
steps.modelAnswer: They took him to the Khalifa because they thought he had stolen the goods and killed the camel.

modelMeaning.hi: वे उसे ख़लीफ़ा के पास ले गए क्योंकि उन्हें लगा कि उसने सामान चुराया और ऊँट को मार दिया।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Woh use Khalifa ke paas le gaye kyonki unhe laga ki usne saamaan churaaya aur oont ko maar diya.

steps.question: How did the old man know that the camel was blind?

questionMeaning.hi: बूढ़े आदमी को कैसे पता चला कि ऊँट अंधा है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Boodhe aadmi ko kaise pata chala ki oont andha hai?

options: It had eaten leaves only on one side of the road.
steps.answer: It had eaten leaves only on one side of the road.
steps.modelAnswer: He knew the camel was blind in one eye because it had eaten the leaves of the bushes only on one side of the road.

modelMeaning.hi: उसे पता था कि ऊँट एक आँख से अंधा है क्योंकि उसने सड़क के सिर्फ़ एक तरफ़ की झाड़ियों के पत्ते खाए थे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Use pata tha ki oont ek aankh se andha hai kyonki usne sadak ke sirf ek taraf ki jhaadiyon ke patte khaaye the.

steps.question: Why were the bees flying only on one side of the road?

questionMeaning.hi: मधुमक्खियाँ सड़क के सिर्फ़ एक तरफ़ क्यों उड़ रही थीं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Madhumakkhiyaan sadak ke sirf ek taraf kyon ud rahi thin?

options: Because honey had dropped on that side.
steps.answer: Because honey had dropped on that side.
steps.modelAnswer: The bees were flying on one side because the camel was carrying honey on that side and some honey had dropped there.

modelMeaning.hi: मधुमक्खियाँ एक तरफ़ उड़ रही थीं क्योंकि ऊँट उस तरफ़ शहद ले जा रहा था और वहाँ शहद गिरा था।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Madhumakkhiyaan ek taraf ud rahi thin kyonki oont us taraf shahad le ja raha tha aur wahan shahad gira tha.

steps.question: Why did the Khalifa not punish the old man?

questionMeaning.hi: ख़लीफ़ा ने बूढ़े आदमी को सज़ा क्यों नहीं दी?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Khalifa ne boodhe aadmi ko saza kyon nahi di?

options: He was innocent; he had only used his eyes.
He paid money to the Khalifa.
steps.answer: He was innocent; he had only used his eyes.
steps.modelAnswer: The Khalifa did not punish the old man because he was innocent. He had only used his eyes to look at things carefully.

modelMeaning.hi: ख़लीफ़ा ने उसे सज़ा नहीं दी क्योंकि वह बेक़सूर था। उसने बस ध्यान से चीज़ें देखी थीं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Khalifa ne use saza nahi di kyonki woh bekasoor tha. Usne bas dhyaan se cheezein dekhi thin.

text.hi: अब किताब का दूसरा भाग: सही विकल्प से वाक्य पूरा करो।
text.hinglish: Ab kitaab ka doosra bhaag: sahi vikalp se vaakya poora karo.
text.en: Now part B of the book: complete each sentence with the correct option.

steps.question: The old man's answers were in the form of ...

questionMeaning.hi: बूढ़े आदमी के जवाब किस रूप में थे?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Boodhe aadmi ke jawab kis roop mein the?

steps.question: The old man asked whether ...

questionMeaning.hi: बूढ़े आदमी ने पूछा कि क्या ...
questionMeaning.hinglish: Boodhe aadmi ne poochha ki kya ...

options: the camel could not walk fast
the camel carried a heavy load

steps.question: The merchants were angry because ...
options: they thought the old man had stolen the goods and killed the camel.
they thought the old man was making fun of them.
they thought they would never get their camel back.
steps.answer: they thought the old man had stolen the goods and killed the camel.

steps.question: The old man knew the camel was lame because ...

questionMeaning.hi: बूढ़ा आदमी जानता था कि ऊँट लंगड़ा है क्योंकि ...
questionMeaning.hinglish: Boodha aadmi jaanta tha ki oont langda hai kyonki ...

options: one of its footprints could hardly be seen
the ants carried fallen grains from one side of the road
he had seen the camel before
steps.answer: one of its footprints could hardly be seen

steps.question: The Khalifa said that the old man knew so much about the camel because ...

questionMeaning.hi: ख़लीफ़ा ने कहा बूढ़ा आदमी इतना जानता था क्योंकि ...
questionMeaning.hinglish: Khalifa ne kaha boodha aadmi itna jaanta tha kyonki ...

options: he used his eyes to look at things carefully
steps.answer: he used his eyes to look at things carefully

steps.question: The camel was ...
options: both lame in one leg and blind in one eye
steps.answer: both lame in one leg and blind in one eye

steps.question: The Khalifa said to the merchants ...
